Name: PLAY_AREA_CREATE_COMMON_PARAM_ST
Description: Shrinking-circle settings shared by every play area: phase start and end times, circle radii and margins, the maximum shrink speed, and the Night Boss site definitions for each day.

Fields.Name: Final Circle Radius
Fields.Description: Radius in metres of the circle after the second shrinking (the end of the day). With Initial Circle Radius it sets the 0-1 shrink progress of the current circle. Retail 40.

Fields.Name: Circle Map Edge Margin Rate
Fields.Description: A new circle position is rejected unless its centre lies at least (radius x this) inside the edge of the 1024 m play map, so 0.5 keeps at least half of the circle on the map. Retail: 0.7 (row 0), 0.5 (rows 1 and 2).

Fields.Name: Circle Max Shrink Speed
Fields.Description: Maximum average speed (m per second of real time) at which the circle edge may move during a phase: a new circle whose centre shift plus radius change, divided by the phase length, exceeds this is rejected, and the phase's circle radius is bounded by it. Retail: 7 (row 0), 16 (rows 1 and 2).

Fields.Name: Divine Tower Second Circle Radius
Fields.Description: Second circle radius in metres for Divine Tower play areas (PlayAreaCreateParam 12000-12999), used instead of Second Circle Radius; in one game state it is also the minimum radius of the inside-the-circle check. Values below 20 use 51. Only row 2 is read. Retail: 51 (rows 0 and 2), 40 (row 1).

Fields.Name: First Circle: Start Hour
Fields.Description: In-game hour when the first circle shrinking starts (with First Circle: Start Minute). Retail 12:30 on row 0.

Fields.Name: First Circle: Start Minute
Fields.Description: Minute part of the first shrinking's start time.

Fields.Name: First Circle: End Hour
Fields.Description: In-game hour when the first shrinking ends (with End Minute); 0:00 means midnight, and an end before the start counts as the next day. Retail 16:09 on row 0.

Fields.Name: First Circle: End Minute
Fields.Description: Minute part of the first shrinking's end time.

Fields.Name: Second Circle: Start Hour
Fields.Description: In-game hour when the second circle shrinking starts (with Start Minute). Retail 20:24 on row 0.

Fields.Name: Second Circle: Start Minute
Fields.Description: Minute part of the second shrinking's start time.

Fields.Name: Second Circle: End Hour
Fields.Description: In-game hour when the second shrinking ends (with End Minute); 0:00 means midnight (retail row 0).

Fields.Name: Second Circle: End Minute
Fields.Description: Minute part of the second shrinking's end time.

Fields.Name: Day 1 Night's Tide SpEffect ID
Fields.Description: No reader found. Retail: 99810 "Night's Tide: Damage (1st Shrinking)" on row 0, -1 on rows 1 and 2.

Fields.Name: Day 2 Night's Tide SpEffect ID
Fields.Description: No reader found. Retail: 99811 "Night's Tide: Damage (2nd Shrinking)" on row 0, -1 on rows 1 and 2.

Fields.Name: Initial Circle Radius
Fields.Description: Radius in metres of the circle before the first shrinking. With Final Circle Radius it sets the 0-1 shrink progress of the current circle. Retail 700 on row 0, 0 on rows 1 and 2.

Fields.Name: Initial Circle: Map ID: AA
Fields.Description: No reader found. Retail: 60 on row 0 (map m60_44_38 with Grid X/Z), 0 on rows 1 and 2.

Fields.Name: Initial Circle: Map ID: BB
Fields.Description: No reader found. Retail: 44 on row 0.

Fields.Name: Initial Circle: Map ID: CC
Fields.Description: No reader found. Retail: 38 on row 0.

Fields.Name: Initial Circle: Position X
Fields.Description: No reader found. Retail: -128 on row 0 (with Z -128 in m60_44_38, which is world position 0, 0 under the play-area grid conversion), 0 on rows 1 and 2.

Fields.Name: Initial Circle: Position Z
Fields.Description: No reader found. Retail: -128 on row 0.

Fields.Name: Event Flag ID
Fields.Description: Event flag ID read when the map pattern is set up. Retail: 7506 (Day 2 preliminary battle has started) on row 0, 0 elsewhere.

Fields.Name: Night Boss Day 1 Site Define ID
Fields.Description: SmallBaseAndSpotDefine row for the Day 1 Night Boss: when a site's map is in this row's map list, the site gets this row. Checked after the regular site defines. 0: none. Retail: 108 (row 0), 2108 (row 1), 0 (row 2).

Fields.Name: Night Boss Day 2 Site Define ID
Fields.Description: As Night Boss Day 1 Site Define ID, for the Day 2 Night Boss; checked when the Day 1 row does not match. Retail: 109 (row 0), 2109 (row 1), 0 (row 2).
